protocol_status: Pre-registration. The screening ran on GPUs (main 5dc653b; follow-ups: mp-multinode C4m, C8m, C16m at 6fe428d; PD retries at 2d104e4, b7760b0 and 50d51d9); results are in docs/report/SCREENING_2026-11-10.md. The rounds ran from 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-17: the D x 2 job and round 1 at the frozen commit c4b22ca, rounds 2 and 3 at the re-frozen commit a8974fa that installs pandas for W1real (round 1 lost W1real; deviations). Every round was valid in both round jobs; results are in docs/report/ROUNDS_2026-11-17.md. The extension rule recommended rounds 4 and 5 for both jobs; they did not run: on 2026-11-17 the user closed the rounds at round 3 (deviations). Round layouts (2026-11-10): A + B0 + D42 (the pre-registered selection) + C8m + D24 (added after the screening by the user's decision; deviations), in an FP8 and an NVFP4 round job per round (rounds.jobs); on 2026-11-11 the user chose the reinforced plan (accuracy on 1,000 items, the D2 control, W1real for the NVFP4 layouts; budget.user_budget). Before round 1, freeze aml/src/bench/ (this file, slo_suites.py, accuracy.py, protocol.sh, bench_stats.py, lb_proxy.py, node_tools.py, nixl_preflight.py) and docs/BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md in one commit; publish every run, including invalid and aborted runs.

selection.label: added after screening
selection.rule: screen.selection chose B0 (FP8) and D42 (NVFP4); the D x 2 decision passed
selection.decision: After the screening report (docs/report/SCREENING_2026-11-10.md) the user chose 'A + B0 + D42 + C8 + D24' (all throughput candidates, about 76 node-hours, about $980); C8 is the mp-multinode layout C8m because the Ray C8 cannot start

deviations.what: C8m and D24 run in the rounds although the pre-registered selection rule (screen.selection) chose only B0 and D42
deviations.why: the user's decision after the screening report: A + B0 + D42 + C8 + D24, all throughput candidates (C8 = the mp-multinode C8m; the Ray C8 cannot start)
deviations.effect: their comparisons are labelled 'added after screening' in every analyze and report output (rounds.selection)

deviations.what: Round 1 ran without W1real: every realtext point failed because vllm bench serve needs pandas for a custom dataset and the vLLM image has none (workloads.W1real.not_run_rounds)
deviations.why: a harness defect found while round 1 ran (W1real had never run on a GPU); it says nothing about the layouts
deviations.effect: the round validity of round 1 does not require realtext; its other suites count as usual. Rounds 2 and 3 run at the re-frozen commit, whose only measuring change is the pandas install before the realtext suite, so the W1real comparisons rest on rounds 2 and 3 (n = 2: wide intervals, mostly inconclusive). Decided before any round-1 result was analyzed

deviations.what: The early-divergence parity check (at most 2 of 32 greedy prompts differing before token 16) is reported as uninformative when the control itself fails it (parity.acceptance.uninformative)
deviations.why: in round 1 the relaunch controls, identical in configuration to their references, diverged early on 9 (A2 vs A) and 8 (D2 vs D) of 32 prompts: run-to-run nondeterminism of batched FP8/NVFP4 MoE inference flips near-tied tokens, so the absolute limit was miscalibrated
deviations.effect: the parity status rests on the two floor-relative checks (mean |delta logprob|, top-1 agreement); the analysis keeps the pre-registered status and both counts. Decided after the round-1 parity and before the parity of rounds 2 and 3

deviations.what: Rounds 4 and 5 did not run although the extension rule (decision_rules.extend) recommended them for both round jobs
deviations.why: the user's decision after round 3: the extension rounds were outside the approved budget (about 22 node-hours, about $280 at the Spot meter per round, estimate), and they were expected to narrow mainly the W1 intervals while most W2 intervals stay wide (estimate)
deviations.effect: every interval and decision comes from rounds 1-3; analyze still reports the extension recommendation and its reasons
